cells.gaps: No source found gives the share of births registered on VitalReg; the NPC's 57% and Nigeria 24's 43% unregistered are national rates not tied to the digital system. UNICEF in June 2026 put the platform in 14 states and the FCT, before the national start.
cells.note: The NPC chairman said digital birth and death registration on VitalReg began in all 36 states and the FCT on 1 July 2026, with paper forms no longer used: births and deaths digital nationally, stage 4. No coverage share of the digital system is held.
